{{Quote|By your command.|This gunship to General Kalani|<ref name="Tipping Points">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>}}
This gunship partook in the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was one of the first of [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunships]] to be used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|C.I.S]]. This droid gunship was ordered to take out the rebel resistance but after the arrival of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] with [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launchers]], the [[Onderon Resistance|rebels]] were able to overpower all of the droid gunships and shoot them down.
